Resolves #21335

The calendar example opens on today, in a team's week: six calendars (Team, and Maya, Jonas, Priya, Leo and Sofia), with 19 events across them that have real titles. The weeks before and after keep the recurring meetings. A line in the header says how to move and resize an event. The three calendar e2e specs, which assert the week of 21 July 2024, run on a fixed-data fixture beside the other e2e fixtures. `calendar-weekview` leaves the catalog.

Intake: the drift probe touched only `examples.json` (#21345's Colors records). The ticket is valid as written, sharpened in its body: the fixture lives in `test/playwright/component/apps/`, and AC-3 moved to #21360. Prescription checked: `examples/calendar/basic/MainContainer.mjs` owns the concern.

Evidence: L3 (e2e specs on the fixture, portal unit specs, a headless browser run on the dev server before and after) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-4, AC-6). Residual: AC-3, Residual-Owner: #21360.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Outside-CI: `createEvents()` for Wed 18 Nov 2026, Sun 15 Nov, Sat 21 Nov and Sun 28 Mar 2027 (a DST change) puts 19 events in today's week across 6 calendars, with 15 distinct titles and no "Event N". The after frames show 15 to 21 November with today marked. |
| AC-2 | Outside-CI: the header reads "Drag an event to move it, drag its lower edge to resize it" (after frame, desktop). At 640 px or less it is hidden: a phone's header has no room for it. |
| AC-3 | Moved to #21360: the calendar cannot be created folded, at phone width the week's header falls out of step with its 17 px columns, and folding after mount leaves the day view on the previous day. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: `CalendarWeekViewSwitch.spec.mjs`, `CalendarMonthRollover.spec.mjs` and `CalendarMonthEventDrag.spec.mjs` in `e2e-engine`, now on `test/playwright/component/apps/calendar-basic`, assertions unchanged. The fixture has no 47 px header toolbar, so at 720 px the rollover spec's month view was 625 px tall instead of 578 and its tall-week check failed on CI (7.6 px of overflow, more than 10 needed); locally it had passed by 1.6 px. `e13c451f1d` sets a 673 px viewport, which restores the 578 px month view. |
| AC-5 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples/MainContainerController.spec.mjs` › "catalogs one Calendar example, the full calendar", with 98 records, 53 of them without a cover. |
| AC-6 | Outside-CI: the frames under Test Evidence. |

## Deltas from ticket

- AC-3 moved to #21360, with the measurements that showed it needs engine fixes.
- The fixture sits at `test/playwright/component/apps/calendar-basic`, where e2e specs already load `dock-lock` and `animated-sort`, not in an examples folder the catalog would have to skip.
- `examples/calendar/basic/data/*.json` goes too: only the old example and `weekview` read it, and the fixture keeps its own copy.
- `seo.json`, `sitemap.xml` and `llms.txt` lose the weekview route by hand. The generator agrees on every route; the `lastmod` drift it would also rewrite is the data-sync pipeline's.
